Gilhouly was a Starfleet admiral who led a task force which was sent to Deep Space 9 in 2373 to protect the station against a possible attack by the Dominion. ()

page.overview:
Who is Gilhouly?

Gilhouly was a Starfleet admiral who led a task force which was sent to Deep Space 9 in 2373 to protect the station against a possible attack by the Dominion. ()
